What characterises the T-cell receptors binding to the peptide–HLA complexes? Save the plot under `results/`.

Main logo is the exercise one: CDR3b length 15, allele `A02:01`, peptide `LLFLVLIML`. The extra logo is one other combination (length 14, same allele, peptide `YLQPRTFLL`).

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggseqlogo)
library(here)

dir.create(here("results"), showWarnings = FALSE)

peptide_meta_data <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "03_dat_aug.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.2
#| fig-cap: "CDR3b sequences of length 15 for A02:01 and LLFLVLIML."

cdr3_main <- peptide_meta_data |>
  filter(
    k_CDR3b == 15,
    Allele == "A02:01",
    peptide == "LLFLVLIML"
  ) |>
  distinct(CDR3b) |>
  pull(CDR3b)

p_cdr3 <- ggseqlogo(cdr3_main, seq_type = "aa")

ggsave(
  here("results", "logo_cdr3_LLFLVLIML_len15.png"),
  p_cdr3,
  width = 7,
  height = 3.2,
  dpi = 130
)

p_cdr3
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.2
#| fig-cap: "Alternate logo: CDR3b length 14, A02:01, peptide YLQPRTFLL."

cdr3_alt <- peptide_meta_data |>
  filter(
    k_CDR3b == 14,
    Allele == "A02:01",
    peptide == "YLQPRTFLL"
  ) |>
  distinct(CDR3b) |>
  pull(CDR3b)

p_alt <- ggseqlogo(cdr3_alt, seq_type = "aa")

ggsave(
  here("results", "logo_cdr3_YLQPRTFLL_len14.png"),
  p_alt,
  width = 7,
  height = 3.2,
  dpi = 130
)

p_alt
```
